title: Claude Cowork
content:
## Overview

Claude Cowork is Anthropic's Claude Code-style agent aimed at general knowledge work rather than software development. You hand Claude a task and it works across your files, calendar, email, messaging apps, the web, and any other connected tools until the job is done — the same agentic loop that powers Claude Code, pointed at an office worker's tools instead of a codebase.

Cowork launched as a desktop app in January 2026. On July 7, 2026, Anthropic expanded it to **web and mobile**, starting with Max plan subscribers.

---

## Cross-Device Continuity

The core pitch of the web/mobile expansion is that a task is no longer tied to one device:

- Start a task from your desk, get status updates on your phone, and pick up the finished output later
- Sessions run remotely (in beta) — work continues even if the laptop is closed
- Scheduled tasks can run with no device online at all
- On web and desktop, chat and Cowork now share one home, with projects and artifacts synced across both

The desktop app remains the place for deep work, since it's the only surface where Claude can access local files and the browser directly.

---

## Human-in-the-Loop Control

Cowork is designed to hand decisions back to the user rather than guessing. When Claude reaches a call only a human can make, it pauses and asks — and that question is pushed to the user's phone, mirroring how this session escalates ambiguous PR-review decisions back to a person rather than acting unilaterally.

---

## Usage Patterns

Anthropic reports that **more than 90% of Cowork usage is not software development**. The largest categories are business operations and content creation — task types like drafting and sending communications, scheduling, research synthesis, and document preparation, rather than writing code.

This distinguishes Cowork from Claude Code: Claude Code assumes a git repository and a shell; Cowork assumes a general digital workspace (inbox, calendar, files, browser) and no assumption of a codebase.

---

## Relationship to Claude Code

Cowork and Claude Code share the same underlying agentic architecture — an agent loop with tool use, scheduled/background task execution, and remote session support in isolated containers (see the Claude Code Overview page for how remote sessions work). The practical difference is the tool surface: Claude Code's tools are file/shell/git-centric; Cowork's tools are calendar/email/messaging/browser-centric. Anthropic appears to be converging the two products' session infrastructure (remote execution, scheduled tasks, cross-device handoff) even as their toolsets stay domain-specific.

---

## Rollout Status (as of July 2026)

- **Desktop:** generally available since January 2026
- **Web and mobile:** rolling out starting July 7, 2026, Max plan first, with more plans to follow
- Claude for Government Desktop also ships Claude Code and Claude Cowork in public beta, delivered through a FedRAMP High authorized environment
